sourceProfile.shape_origin: declared example; statically inferred, not observed
sourceProfile.drawing_scope: One BigGAN Attention module; SNConv2d is a normalized-weight call boundary, see separate SNLinear mechanism.

sourceFacts: Theta remains full-resolution; phi and g use max pooling and therefore have four times fewer spatial positions.
Softmax normalizes the last pooled-position axis. No 1/sqrt(d) scale or positional embedding appears.
theta,phi,g,o weights are four independent instances; gamma is a learned scalar initialized zero.
Source y argument is unused. It is not an additional condition input in this attention view.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
